purpose: Clinical decision distances frozen before computing cost (same approach as frozen_map). Fixes per-direction distances for the misclassification pairs of the MSI-H and anti-EGFR axes (mean_cost=null in routing_cost.json) before the misroute direction distribution is seen.
frozen_before_running: before recomputing the real MIL misclassification direction distribution (FN/FP)
not_drp: These distances are treatment-routing substitution costs based on clinical outcomes (PFS/OS/toxicity), not drug-structure inputs. Not drug response prediction. hypothesis_only.
distance_scale: 0 (substitution harmless) to 1 (maximum substitution harm). Per direction (FN = marker-positive called negative, FP = marker-negative called positive).
mean_cost_formula: mean_cost = (n_FN * d_FN + n_FP * d_FP) / n_holdout. If d_FN=d_FP=D this reduces to misroute_rate*D (same as the braf formula).

d_FN.event: MSI-H called MSS -> first-line pembrolizumab not given (undertreatment)
d_FN.anchor: KEYNOTE-177 (André NEJM 2020): dMMR/MSI-H mCRC first-line pembrolizumab vs chemotherapy, median PFS 16.5 vs 8.2 mo (HR 0.60), durable responses. Missing it loses a 2x PFS benefit and durable response -> large decision distance.

d_FP.event: MSS called MSI-H -> ineligible patient flagged for ICI (overtreatment)
d_FP.anchor: Single-agent ICI ORR ~0% in MSS mCRC (KEYNOTE-177 was dMMR only, MSS excluded). H&E routing triggers confirmatory MSI/MMR testing rather than final Rx -> harm is mostly delayed effective chemotherapy plus unnecessary testing (reversible) -> intermediate decision distance.

d_FN.event: Eligible (WT) called ineligible -> anti-EGFR not given to an eligible patient (undertreatment)
d_FN.anchor: FIRE-3 (Heinemann Lancet Oncol 2014): in RAS-WT, FOLFIRI+cetuximab vs +bevacizumab, OS 33.1 vs 25.0 mo. Loss of OS benefit, especially in left-sided tumours -> large decision distance.

d_FP.event: Ineligible (RAS/BRAF-mut) called eligible -> anti-EGFR given to an ineligible patient (active harm)
d_FP.anchor: PRIME (Douillard NEJM 2013): adding panitumumab in RAS-mut is detrimental to PFS/OS. No efficacy + grade 3 skin toxicity + cost -> the most harmful direction (active harm exceeds missed benefit).

braf_v600_note.primary_mean_cost_source: frozen_map antiBRAF__baseline=0.868 (cell-line therapeutic distance); mean_cost=0.086 from routing_cost.json v1 unchanged.
braf_v600_note.scale_caveat: braf mean_cost is on the cell-line frozen_map scale; MSI/anti-EGFR mean_cost is on the clinical-decision scale. The three mean_cost values are not directly comparable or rankable.

d_FN.event: BRAF-V600E called WT -> encorafenib+cetuximab not given
d_FN.anchor: BEACON (Kopetz NEJM 2019): BRAF-V600E mCRC enco+cetux vs chemotherapy, OS 8.4 vs 5.4 mo, ORR 20% vs 2%.

d_FP.event: WT called BRAF-V600E -> inappropriate BRAF-targeted therapy
d_FP.anchor: BRAF doublet is ineffective without V600E; adds toxicity and cost, but confirmatory BRAF testing is standard -> intermediate.
